title: The Information-Processing Universe: Spacetime as a Lossy Projection of a Hidden Informational Dimension and a Gravitationally Running Tsirelson Bound
content: I propose that spacetime is a discrete, lossy rendering of a continuous, non-local information space, the Hidden Informational Dimension (HID). The rendering occurs at a granularity set by Planck’s constant, and each processing tick transmits the relational information of a joint measurement with fidelity equal to the overlap of the questions asked. The resulting dressing law, Eobs(a, b) = −sgn(a·b) |a·b|p, reproduces the complete quantum singlet correlator at unit dressing exponent and retrodicts the Tsirelson bound as B = 4 · 2−1/2 = 2√2. The tick law is itself derived from the granularity postulate up to a single frame-selection axiom: its covariant rival and its dispersive alternative are excluded by existing experiments, the latter at ∼200σ, certifying the processing sequence as a deterministic clock. The exponent is identified with the local processing rate—the gravitational time-dilation factor, augmented by a cosmological entropy term—so the framework contains no free parameters beyond a single gauge choice: the processing foliation is identified with the comoving cosmic rest frame, anchoring the exponent to unity at the cosmic mean potential of the present epoch. A rendered universe is quantum while 1 ≤ p ≤ 2; at horizons p → 0 and the bare no-signalling statistics (B = 4) are exposed; at the entropic limit p → ∞ and correlation dies. The accompanying strong-gravity violation of information causality is quantified and quarantined: a final-station composition theorem forbids its export, and the collapse of communication complexity is confined to r < 1.52 rs, just outside the photon sphere. The theory therefore predicts a running Tsirelson bound, B(p) = 4 · 2−p/2, together with a characteristic deformation of the correlation curve that is pinned at aligned and conjugate settings and maximal near cos θ = e−1—a signature no noise process can imitate—and an absolute, one-sided offset of (1–6) × 10−5 above 2√2 in every terrestrial laboratory, which sits in the potential well of local large-scale structure. Information loss is priced by Landauer’s principle—each CHSHoptimal readout erases exactly half a bit—gravitation is embedded as processing-rate modulation, and the cyclic waveform of the universe is identified with the sign-extended “necklace” instantons of the minisuperspace no-boundary path integral. A staged experimental programme, from tabletop Tsirelson-saturation tests to a solar-orbit Bell mission, is proposed.
